empty.sharedHint: When a teammate shares a conversation or an account with you, it shows up here.

toast.failed: That did not work. Nothing changed.

thread.toAliasHint: Written to this address. Show its mail

composer.subject: Subject

composer.noAccount: Connect a mail account to send mail
composer.waitUploads: Wait for the uploads to finish
composer.discardDraftConfirm: Discard this draft? It is deleted from the mail account too.

comments.title: Team comments
comments.hint: Only teammates who can see this conversation read comments. They never reach the sender.
comments.deleteConfirm: Delete this comment? Teammates will no longer see it.
comments.empty: No comments yet. Discuss this conversation with your team here.

share.description: Share just this conversation. The rest of the account stays as it is.
share.everyoneHint: Every member can open this conversation.
share.accountAudience: People who see the account see this conversation too.

assign.hint: Assignees can see and answer this conversation.

audience.sharedHint: Teammates you choose read and answer it with you.
audience.pickHint: Only the teams and people you pick
audience.needSomeone: Pick at least one team or person, or share with everyone

accounts.title: Mail accounts
accounts.description: Your own mail accounts, read and answered in opendesk like a mail client. Each change happens at your provider too.
accounts.pausedHint: Collab is off for this workspace. The account syncs again when it is back on.

empty.title: No mail accounts yet
empty.description: Connect a Google, Microsoft or IMAP account to read and answer its mail here.

accounts.connected: {{email}} is connected. Its mail is syncing.

error.oauth_state: The sign-in expired or came from another browser. Try again.
error.provider_error: The provider refused the connection. Try again in a moment.
error.account_conflict: Someone in this workspace already connected that address.
error.collab_required: Collab is not on this workspace's plan.
error.forbidden: You cannot connect accounts in this workspace.
error.internal: Something went wrong. Try again in a moment.

upsell.title: Collab is not on this plan
upsell.description: Connect your own mail accounts with the Collab plan.
upsell.disabled: Collab is turned off on this instance.

connect.title: Connect a mail account
connect.imapHint: Any server with IMAP and SMTP
connect.none: No provider is set up on this instance yet. Ask whoever runs it to add a Google or Microsoft client, or turn on IMAP.
connect.openedInBrowser: The sign-in opened in your browser. Finish it there, then come back.
connect.loginHint: Optional: the address to sign in with
connect.name: Name in the sidebar
connect.appPasswordHint: {{host}} needs an app password, made in its account settings.
connect.usernames: Usernames, when they are not the address
connect.smtpPasswordHint: Only when it differs from the IMAP password
connect.nothingDeleted: opendesk never deletes mail at your provider.

detail.name: Name in the sidebar
detail.fromNameHint: How your name reads on mail you send from this account
detail.colorHint: Its dot in the sidebar and on conversations
detail.signatureHint: Added to new mail and replies from this account
detail.sharingHint: Who reads and answers this account's mail with you
detail.serverHint: New settings are tried before they are saved
detail.passwordUnchanged: Leave empty to keep the current password. A new server needs the password again.
detail.disconnectText: Its mail, comments and shares leave opendesk. Nothing is deleted at the provider: your mail stays in your account.
detail.disconnectHint: Removes the account and its mail from opendesk. Nothing is deleted at the provider.
detail.readOnly: Only whoever connected this account, or a workspace admin for a shared one, can change it.
detail.reconnectHint: The provider refused the saved sign-in. Connect it again to resume syncing.

signatureSync.two_way: Synced with Gmail. Changes here update Gmail too, and changes in Gmail show up here.
signatureSync.read_only: Read from Gmail. Reconnect the account to edit your Gmail signature from here.
signatureSync.microsoft: Outlook doesn't share signatures with apps, so this signature lives in opendesk.

fromNameSync.two_way: Synced with Gmail: a change here changes it in Gmail too.
fromNameSync.read_only: Read from Gmail. Reconnect the account to change it in Gmail from here.
fromNameSync.microsoft: Follows your Microsoft profile until you change it here.

ooo.title: Out of office
ooo.hint: An automatic reply to mail that arrives while you're away

two_way.google: Synced with Gmail's vacation responder. Changes here update Gmail too.
two_way.microsoft: Synced with Outlook's automatic replies. Changes here update Outlook too.

read_only.google: Read from Gmail. Reconnect the account to change it from here.
read_only.microsoft: Read from Outlook. Reconnect the account to change it from here.

none.microsoft: Reconnect the account to see and change its Outlook automatic replies here.
none.imap: IMAP servers don't share automatic replies with apps. Set one up with your mail provider.

ooo.startHint: Optional. Without a date it starts right away.
ooo.endHint: Optional. Without a date it replies until you turn it off.
ooo.needBothHint: Optional. To schedule it, Outlook needs both a start and an end.
ooo.subject: Subject
ooo.messagePlaceholder: Thanks for your email. I'm away and will reply when I'm back.
ooo.contactsOnlyHintMicrosoft: People in your organization always get the reply.
ooo.internalOnlyHintMicrosoft: People outside your organization get no reply.
ooo.endBeforeStart: The end has to come after the start.
ooo.needBoth: Outlook needs both a start and an end to schedule a reply.

notifications.assignedAnon: A conversation was assigned to you
notifications.mentionAnon: You were mentioned in a comment

tabs.title: Customize tabs
tabs.description: Choose which folders show as tabs above your mail, and in what order. Everything else stays in More.
tabs.noTabs: No tabs. Check anything below to show it here.
tabs.limit: The bar holds up to 30 tabs.
tabs.saveFailed: Your tabs could not be saved

details.subject: subject
details.noTls: Not encrypted on the way in
details.spoofedBody: It failed its sender's checks, so it may not really be from {{domain}}. Avoid its links and files, and don't reply with personal details.
details.unverifiedBody: Nothing confirms this message came from {{domain}}. Take care with its links and files.

addresses.title: Addresses
addresses.hint_google: The addresses Gmail lets this account send as. Add or remove them in Gmail's settings (Accounts, Send mail as); changes show here within 15 minutes.
addresses.hint_microsoft: Aliases this mailbox sends from. Microsoft does not share them with opendesk, so add them here. Its organization has to allow sending from aliases, or Outlook refuses the message.
addresses.hint_imap: Other addresses this account sends from. Its SMTP server decides whether it accepts them.
addresses.emailHint: An alias of this mailbox, for example sales@yourcompany.com.
addresses.suggestions: Microsoft knows these addresses for this mailbox:
addresses.fromNameHint: Empty uses the account's From name, {{name}}.
addresses.replyToHint: Replies go to this address instead. Leave empty to get them here.
addresses.signatureHint: Added to mail sent from this address.
addresses.pendingHint: Gmail is waiting for this address to be confirmed. Open the link Gmail emailed to it, then it can send. Until then it shows here but cannot be picked.
addresses.primaryHint: Its From name and signature are the account's, above.
addresses.sync_pull: Kept in opendesk, follows changes in Gmail
addresses.syncLine_pull: Gmail only lets other apps change the main address's signature and From name, so this address's are kept in opendesk and used when you send from it. Changes made in Gmail still come in.
addresses.syncLine_none: Kept in opendesk and used when you send from this address.
addresses.removeText: You will no longer be able to send from this address in opendesk. Nothing changes at the provider.
addresses.emptyHint: Add an alias to send from it and give it its own signature.

sender.kept: Uses variables, so it is kept in opendesk; Gmail keeps its own.
sender.varsHint: Click a variable to name whoever sends: on a shared account, each person's mail carries their own name.

vars.agent: The full name of whoever sends
vars.agent_first: The first name of whoever sends

sender.signatureVars: Type a variable to add the sender's name, title or phone: each person's mail carries their own.
